whenToUse: When possible causes of a problem are to be collected, ordered by 6M and rated by the team, so that the most likely ones get tested with experiments; states can be kept as snapshots and compared. For a single chain of causes by asking why, use 5-Why.
name: Ishikawa 6M
description: Root cause analysis with 6M categories and expert scoring
problemPlaceholder: e.g. Scrap rate for part X increased by 12%…
expertDuplicate: An expert with this name already exists.
trendMinSnaps: At least 1 snapshot + current state needed.
loadSnapConfirm: Overwrite current state with this snapshot?
delRowConfirmWithSubs: Really delete hypothesis "{name}"? This will also delete {count} sub-hypothesis.
delRowConfirmWithSubs_other: Really delete hypothesis "{name}"? This will also delete {count} sub-hypotheses.
renameCatsHint: Optionally provide a case-specific term for each category. Leave empty to use the default name.
problemScopeInHint: Images that show the problem — typical failure images considered in the Ishikawa.
problemScopeOutHint: Images that should NOT be considered — to clearly delimit what is explicitly NOT the problem.
imageTooLarge: "{name}" could not be compressed below 100 KB — please choose a smaller image.
noFacts: No facts recorded yet. Click "+ Fact" to add the first one.
chooseHypothesesHint: Select the hypotheses this experiment helps to verify.
noExperiments: No experiments planned yet. Click "+ Experiment" to add the first one.
ganttNoData: No experiments with start and due date.
costChartNoData: No experiments with cost or effort.
chooseExperimentsHint: Select the experiments that help verify hypothesis "{name}".
noExperimentsToLink: No experiments created yet. Switch to the "Experiments" tab to add the first one.

invariants.uniqueExpertNames: Every expert needs a name of their own; case does not matter.
invariants.uniqueRowIds: Every cause needs its own id and its own non-empty identifier such as H-001.
invariants.validParents: The parent cause of a sub-cause must exist; causes must not refer to each other in a loop.
invariants.subRowsWithoutCategory: Only main causes carry a category; sub-causes have none and inherit that of their main cause.
invariants.uniqueItemIds: Every expert, snapshot, experiment, fact and image needs an id of its own; the images of both galleries share their ids.
